objective: Read-only CI and publish jobs set permissions contents read on the job itself. Existing SHA pins, persist-credentials false, Dependabot, and the pypi environment stay. CONTRIBUTING.md and CHANGELOG Unreleased document the rule, and tests lock the pins, permissions, Dependabot schedule, and pypi environment.

pytest reports that dependabot schedules github-actions weekly
pytest reports that the publish job keeps environment name pypi
